# Jinsey Lab

> Jinsey Lab is a software company founded in 2026 that builds and ships its own products: MyCoder, a policy-enforced coding agent for the terminal; PaperPilot, a local-first arXiv radar and paper workspace; and FinalPilot, a local-first exam review workspace. All products are free and MIT-licensed. The lab also publishes research in quantum compilation.

## Products

- [MyCoder](https://jinseylab.tech/mycoder/): Coding agent for the terminal. Every tool call is decided by a policy engine before it runs. Zero runtime dependencies; Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenAI-compatible models. Distributed on npm (`mycoder-cli`) and Homebrew. Status: alpha (0.1.0-alpha.14).
- [PaperPilot](https://jinseylab.tech/paperpilot/): Daily arXiv radar ranked against a research profile, with a reader and structured AI notes stored as local Markdown. CLI and Web UI.
- [FinalPilot](https://jinseylab.tech/finalpilot/): Turns lecture slides, notes, and past exams into source-linked study notes and exam review packs. Local-first web app.
